problem.zh: Problem: 把复杂项目与竞赛成果剪成可传播、可理解的 narrative output
problem.en: Problem: recut complex work and awards into communication-friendly narrative output

heroSummary.zh: 这部分展示的是我如何把项目、服务学习和比赛题材转化为更容易被理解与传播的叙事成果。
heroSummary.en: This section shows how I turn projects, service-learning work, and competition themes into communication-friendly narrative outputs.

value.zh: 视频、海报、竞赛作品和对外传播材料。
value.en: Videos, posters, competition work, and outward-facing communication assets.

value.zh: 它们说明我不仅能做系统，也能把复杂工作讲清楚、剪出来、展示出去。
value.en: They show that beyond building systems, I can explain complex work clearly, edit it into strong media, and present it outward.

items.zh: 把技术或服务项目转成更能被评审、老师和公众理解的 narrative output。
items.en: Turned technical or service projects into narrative outputs that judges, teachers, and public audiences can understand.

items.zh: 长期做视频与比赛交付，训练了我在时间限制下组织内容、控制节奏和表达重点的能力。
items.en: Long-term delivery across videos and competitions strengthened my ability to structure content, control pacing, and communicate priorities under time constraints.
